dedicate.en: The research team dedicated the remaining months to refining the survey instrument.
dedicate.zh: 研究团队把余下的几个月全部投入到问卷工具的完善之中。

dedicate.en: This volume is dedicated to all those who sustained the project through difficult years.
dedicate.zh: 本卷献给所有在艰难岁月里支撑这一项目的人。

dedicate.en: The foundation dedicated its resources to rural literacy programs rather than urban infrastructure.
dedicate.zh: 该基金会将资源用于农村扫盲项目，而非城市基础设施建设。

depict.en: Recent studies depict the relationship between bilingualism and executive control as bidirectional.
depict.zh: 近期研究把双语能力与执行控制之间的关系描绘为双向的。

depict.en: The report depicts rural households as primary caregivers within the extended family structure.
depict.zh: 该报告把农村家庭描绘为扩展型家庭结构中的主要照料者。

depict.en: Archaeological evidence from the site depicts a trading settlement of considerable complexity.
depict.zh: 来自该遗址的考古证据描绘出一个相当复杂的贸易聚落。

displace.en: Automation displaced many routine clerical jobs within the banking sector.
displace.zh: 自动化取代了银行业中许多常规的文书岗位。

displace.en: Rising rents displaced long-established families from the inner urban districts.
displace.zh: 不断上涨的租金迫使长期居住的家庭迁出城市内城区。

displace.en: New evidence has displaced the earlier account of how the species dispersed.
displace.zh: 新的证据已取代了先前关于该物种扩散过程的说法。

emerge.en: A clear pattern emerged from the interview data once the coding process was completed.
emerge.zh: 在编码过程完成之后，访谈数据中呈现出清晰的模式。

emerge.en: The dispute emerged when the ministry published revised allocation figures without prior consultation.
emerge.zh: 当主管部门未经事先协商便公布修订后的分配数据时，这场争议浮现出来。

emerge.en: New forms of collective action emerged across several districts during the following winter.
emerge.zh: 在随后的冬季，若干地区涌现出新的集体行动形式。

intensify.en: Governments may intensify the effect of public spending through better administrative targeting.
intensify.zh: 政府可以通过更精准的行政投放来加强公共支出的效果。

intensify.en: Competition for scarce grants tends to intensify once the funding pool is reduced.
intensify.zh: 一旦资金池缩减，对稀缺资助的竞争便会加剧。

intensify.en: Regulators intensify their scrutiny when reported cases of misconduct become more frequent.
intensify.zh: 当被报告的不当行为案例增多时，监管者会加强审查。

incur.en: Farmers who neglected soil conservation incurred substantial losses during the subsequent drought.
incur.zh: 忽视土壤保持的农户在随后的干旱中遭受了巨大损失。

incur.en: Any applicant who withdraws late will incur the full processing fee.
incur.zh: 任何逾期撤回的申请人都将被收取全额手续费。

incur.en: The hospital incurred substantial costs in training staff on the newly introduced protocol.
incur.zh: 该医院为培训员工掌握新引入的操作规程承担了大量成本。

portray.en: The documentary portrays rural teachers as central to the reform of local schooling.
portray.zh: 这部纪录片把乡村教师刻画为当地学校教育改革的核心。

portray.en: Novels of the period portray the factory as a source of both discipline and menace.
portray.zh: 这一时期的小说把工厂表现为既是纪律之源，也是威胁之源。

portray.en: Public-health campaigns portray excessive sugar intake as a leading dietary risk.
portray.zh: 公共卫生宣传把过量摄入糖分表现为主要的膳食风险。

stipulate.en: The grant agreement stipulates that all data must be deposited in an open archive.
stipulate.zh: 资助协议明确规定，所有数据必须存入一个开放档案库。

stipulate.en: Contractual rules stipulate a minimum notice period before any major restructuring.
stipulate.zh: 合同条款规定，任何重大重组之前必须遵守最短通知期的规定。

stipulate.en: Reviewers stipulate that authors must declare all potential sources of conflict.
stipulate.zh: 评审人要求作者必须申报一切潜在的利益冲突来源。

stress.en: The introduction stresses the need to distinguish correlation from causal inference.
stress.zh: 引言强调必须区分相关性与因果推断。

stress.en: The minister stressed the need for transparent reporting of regional differences.
stress.zh: 部长着重指出有必要对地区差异进行透明报告。

stress.en: Reviewers stress that the effect remains substantial after the sample is reduced.
stress.zh: 评审人强调，在缩减样本之后该效应依然相当显著。

weaken.en: The robustness checks did not weaken the main conclusion of the analysis.
weaken.zh: 稳健性检验并未削弱该分析的主要结论。

weaken.en: Rising competition weakened the authority of the traditional regulating body.
weaken.zh: 日益激烈的竞争削弱了传统监管机构的权威。

weaken.en: Repeated revisions of the instrument weakened its construct validity over time.
weaken.zh: 对该工具的反复修订逐渐削弱了它的构念效度。

ambiguity.en: The ambiguity of the term prevented reviewers from reaching a shared interpretation.
ambiguity.zh: 该术语的含混之处使评审人无法达成一致的解读。

ambiguity.en: Ambiguity in the coding guidelines led two coders to assign different labels.
ambiguity.zh: 编码指南中的歧义导致两名编码者给出了不同的标注。

ambiguity.en: Policy documents should avoid ambiguity whenever enforcement depends on precise wording.
ambiguity.zh: 凡是执法依赖于精确措辞的场合，政策文件都应当避免歧义。

component.en: Each component of the scale was validated against an established external criterion.
component.zh: 该量表的每一个成分都对照已有的外部效标进行了验证。

component.en: The model combines several components, including demography and institutional trust.
component.zh: 该模型结合了若干组成部分，包括人口统计特征与制度信任。

component.en: Researchers replaced a component of the index after a factor analysis revealed redundancy.
component.zh: 在因子分析显示存在冗余之后，研究者替换了该指数中的一个成分。

consequence.en: The long-term consequence of early vocabulary instruction remains a matter of debate.
consequence.zh: 早期词汇教学的长期后果仍是一个存在争议的问题。

consequence.en: Policy makers underestimated the consequence of withdrawing subsidies from small farms.
consequence.zh: 决策者低估了取消对小型农场补贴所造成的后果。

consequence.en: A consequence of the sampling design was that older respondents were underrepresented.
consequence.zh: 抽样设计带来的一项后果是年长受访者代表不足。

construction.en: The construction of the case study required access to archival and interview data.
construction.zh: 该案例研究的建构需要获取档案资料与访谈资料。

construction.en: The meaning of the term is largely a construction of disciplinary discourse.
construction.zh: 该术语的含义在很大程度上是学科话语的建构。

construction.en: The construction of the survey instrument was revised after a pilot study revealed redundancy.
construction.zh: 在先导研究显示存在冗余之后，问卷工具的构造经过了修订。
